text:
sara_sales: Heads-up — customer POC is blocked. Their project-scoped API key returns 401. Demo in ~2 hours. Need quick help.

alex_se: Can you paste the exact curl and the response body? 401 usually includes a reason.

sara_sales: They sent this: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_p_demo_ABC987\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-rlhf-v2\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: `\{"error\":\"invalid_key\",\"detail\":\"key not bound to project\"\}`

jamal_support: That screams binding mismatch. Project-scoped keys must be tied to project_id in the control plane. Ask them to hit the key lookup endpoint.

maria_eng: Exact lookup command: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_p_demo_ABC987\" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/internal/keys/lookup
```
It returns `binding_type`, `project_id`, `scopes`.

alex_se: Sent that to customer — they replied the lookup shows `\{"binding_type\":\"project\",\"project_id\":\"proj-22b\",\"scopes\":[\"generate\"]\}` but their POC app lives in `proj-22a`. They claim they created the key in proj-22a via console.

olivia_sre: Could be console context bug where the UI drops the selected project and creates keys in the last active project. I'll search audit logs for the key creation event id.

sara_sales: They exported audit CSV and gave `request_id: r_20260601_c3f2`.

maria_eng: Good — that request_id should show create_key payload with project_id. Jamal/Olivia can you grep the control-plane audit for that id?

olivia_sre: Found it: r_20260601_c3f2 shows `create_key` -> `project_id: proj-22b`. So console created it in proj-22b. Looks like session context mismatch.

jamal_support: For the demo we can either: 1) reissue a new project-scoped key under proj-22a and rotate it into their app (recommended), or 2) temporarily whitelist the current key to allow proj-22a access (security approval required). Which does customer want?

sara_sales: They're leaning to quick fix (whitelist) to avoid re-deploying their POC before demo. They asked about pricing impact.

alex_se: No pricing change for either. Whitelisting is an operational exception and needs sec approval; reissue is straightforward and safer. Recommend reissue unless they explicitly need zero-change on their side.

maria_eng: Procedure to reissue: In console navigate Project Settings -> API Keys -> Create. Make sure the project dropdown shows `proj-22a` (we should screenshot). Or we can server-side create a key for them if they want — need their project_id and a short auth from their admin.

jamal_support: I'm available to help them rotate keys now. Sara, want me on call?

sara_sales: Yes please join. I'll DM meeting link. Also note: their usage of rerank endpoint earlier failed with 403 because their scopes only included `generate`. They later added embeddings but missed rerank. Double-check scopes in new key.

maria_eng: Scopes to include: `[\"generate\",\"rerank\",\"embeddings\"]` if they're using all three. The lookup response will show current scopes.

olivia_sre: I'll add an urgent UI flag to the console to surface the selected project when creating keys and add a warning if project dropdown doesn't match session. Also file a tiny bugfix to avoid context leakage.

deploy-bot: [deploy] prod/console v1.34.2 scheduled patch to show project-badge on key creation form.

sara_sales: Thanks team. Jamal, please confirm when rotation or whitelist is done so I can update customer before the demo. If security needs to approve whitelist escalate to sec@redwood and include the audit export.

jamal_support: On it, will post status after rotation. :thumbsup:
